name: nook
description: Nook — app xã hội camera-first. Kho gộp: shared + backend. Frontend đứng riêng (Expo có luật gói riêng).

scripts.dev:be: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @nook/backend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w @nook/shared && npm run check -w @nook/backend
scripts.reset:db: docker compose -f backend/docker/compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f backend/docker/compose.dev.yml up -d
